messages:
Alex: Quick sync — wavefront ops + KV cache rollout. Need owners and gating clarity for tomorrow's canary (08:00 PT). Who's taking kernel shim PR and memguard hook? cc @Mira @Sam
Mira: I can own the kernel shim PR. planning to land after perf tests. can someone kick off the ML perf harness for sequence_len=512? :rocket:
Sam: I'll take memguard hook. PR is #3421. Need a reviewer for the safety guard and a sanity perf check. @Marcus can you review? :eyes:
Jia: Eng-infra dependency: the canary requires a small LB rule change and a new autoscale threshold. I put infra changes in infra-ticket-789. ETA for those is today 17:00 PT.
Alex: Great. Gate metrics: p50 < 80ms, p95 < 180ms, error rate < 0.1% during 30m canary, and no KV cache hitrate dip > 5%. If memguard adds allocations, we need to watch GPU mem pressure.
DevOps-bot: deploy-scheduler: Canary scheduled: 2026-03-19T08:00:00-07:00 for services: runtime-kernel-canary, kvcache-canary. Deploy window 30m. Link: https://deploys/redwood/12345
Sam: Re: reviewers — @Marcus + @Mira? Marcus: you in for CR? Also adding a smokecheck script:
```
#!/bin/bash
curl -s -X POST https://internal-api.redwood/v1/generate -d '{"prompt":"hello"}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer $DEV_KEY' | jq -r .id
```
Run that against canary and check p95.
Marcus: Yep, I'll review CR #3421 today and jump on perf if Mira posts the harness link. Also flagging a TODO: add KV-prefetch metrics to the console dashboards.
Mira: Perf harness started: https://ci/redwood/jenkins/flow/8245 — running sequence=128/256/512. I'll post summary in this thread when done.
Alex: Thanks all. Action items: Mira -> land shim after perf green. Sam -> land memguard and add smokecheck. Jia -> finish infra LB/autoscale by 17:00 PT. Marcus -> review CRs. I'll coordinate the canary at 08:00 PT and watch the metrics dashboard. Ping here with blockers. :white_check_mark:
